issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite conventions requiring test-first coverage for every feature.
Three junk new files with embedded newlines in their paths duplicate enum/exception code and must be removed.
Task requires updating both docs but business-rules.md is untouched and database-schema.md only gets a one-line note.
Docs are not kept in sync beyond CHANGELOG, violating the keep-docs-in-sync convention.
Ticket mass-assignment allows code/status/called_* fields with no controller/policy boundary in the diff.
Write-once is enforced only in saving() so query-builder updates bypass the LogicException.
Ticket::call does not lock/refresh the row so concurrent calls could both pass the waiting check.
TicketFactory allocates codes in afterMaking so count(2) batch creates can compute the same next code before either is saved.
nextCode loads every code in the queue into PHP instead of a narrower query.
Added exception file has no trailing newline and junk filenames hurt readability.

conventions.evidence: Follows Actions (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:32), reversible down() (database/migrations/2026_10_29_032851_create_queues_table.php:441-444), CHANGELOG entry (CHANGELOG.md:9); violates test-first (no tests/*) and docs-sync (docs/business-rules.md missing).

readability.evidence: Clear names and small methods (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:34, app/Models/Ticket.php:293 nextCode, app/Models/Ticket.php:308 call); hurt by junk quoted filenames and missing newline at app/Exceptions/InactiveQueueException.php:10.

requirements.evidence: Core met: nextCode orderBy id + /^A(\d+)$/ + str_pad (app/Models/Ticket.php:293-306), lockForUpdate + is_active recheck (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:41-45), 5-attempt retry (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:47-68), write-once saving() (app/Models/Ticket.php:267-281), call() waiting/auth (app/Models/Ticket.php:308-325); missing docs/business-rules.md update and only a one-line docs/database-schema.md:492 edit.

security.evidence: Present: priority guard (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:36-38), AuthorizationException on non-member (app/Models/Ticket.php:314-318), status-first check (app/Models/Ticket.php:310); gaps: broad #[Fillable] (app/Models/Ticket.php:251), saving()-only immutability bypassable via query builder.

simplicity.evidence: Lean 61-line IssueTicket reusing Eloquent/DB transaction; penalized by 3 duplicated junk files and full-table pluck('code') in app/Models/Ticket.php:297.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/* or *Test.php hunks; only production, migration, factory and docs files.

review.summary: Implements the queue/ticket domain core correctly including nextCode edges, row locking, retry, write-once and single-call auth. Missing tests, missing business-rules docs update, and junk duplicate files with malformed paths require substantial rework before merge.
